title: The empty state flashes on every load because isLoading is never consulted
detail: useLibrary exposes isLoading and LibraryPage ignores it, rendering `filteredBooks.length > 0 ? grid : 'Your library is quiet'`. Until IndexedDB resolves, books is [], so every visit to the home route paints a full empty-state screen with an 'Add Your First Book' call to action before the real library replaces it.

title: Filtering to an empty result offers 'Add Your First Book' instead of clearing the filter
detail: The CTA is gated only on !searchQuery, so a user with 200 books who selects 'Finished' and has none is told to add their first book. The obvious action — reset the filter — is not offered.

title: An empty library shows hardcoded recommendations with a refresh button that silently does nothing
detail: recommendations defaults to RECOMMENDED_BOOKS so the carousel always renders, but refreshRecommendations returns immediately when books.length === 0. The user sees a Refresh control that never changes anything and no explanation.

title: The active category chip is near-invisible in dark mode
detail: bg-gray-900 text-white with no dark variant on a dark:bg-night page. Same defect class as the quiz's Next button (S058) and the voice chip (S086) — a hardcoded dark surface used as a selected state.

title: previewRecommendation does not preview — it creates the book and navigates away
detail: The name survives from the removed preview flow. It also awaits getSummary(created.id) at line 95 and discards the result, which is a database round trip with no effect.

title: categories rebuilds a Set over the whole library on every render
detail: Unlike filteredBooks it is not memoised, so every keystroke in the search box re-derives it.

title: Status filter labels and the empty-state icon lack dark variants
detail: text-emerald-700 and text-amber-700 for the active Finished / Want to Read tabs, and text-gray-300 on the empty-state glyph.
